name: Finished projects + rough dates for P2/P3 (Jan – May 2027)
description: Marks Eagle Vision, Meza Order and the Greenhouse placement as Completed. Gives P2/P3 projects start/target dates after the 8-week focus, each with a first task.

projects.label: Smart Water Monitoring and Management System

tasks.title: Validate depth readings against known water levels
tasks.acceptance_criteria: At least 3 reference depths measured; readings and errors recorded as Measured evidence.

tasks.title: Test offline queue and resend with original timestamps
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Gateway offline for 1 hour; all readings arrive later with their original timestamps.

tasks.title: Single-sensor RS485 Modbus test with correct power and direction control
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Stable Modbus readings from one sensor for 10 minutes; wiring photo uploaded to Documents.

tasks.title: Test relay (GPIO33) and solenoid valve safely
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Valve opens and closes on command 20 times without failure.

tasks.title: Reproducible inference script tested on a labelled image set
tasks.acceptance_criteria: export.pkl loads; accuracy on a small labelled set recorded as Measured evidence.

tasks.title: Verify local environment and PostgreSQL connection
tasks.acceptance_criteria: App starts, tables exist, dashboard loads.

tasks.title: Per-bike unit-economics model and pilot plan
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Conservative model (costs, daily rent, utilisation, payback) saved in Documents and the main figures in Business.

tasks.title: Specify secure token generation and anti-replay scheme
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Written spec covering 20-digit tokens, reuse protection and balance persistence on power loss.

tasks.title: Decide: new product or the next version of Meza Order
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Decision written as a Decision note in Documents.
